# Understanding the nexus

<!-- GENERATED by `work weave` from skills/understanding_the_nexus.work — do not edit; edit the source docs it composes. -->

The **nexus** is the runtime that backs `server` units, agents, data, sync, and the
compile/weave lane — one nexus serves many sites. Understanding it explains where
server-side code runs, how a workbook is hosted, and why one nexus is the org. This
skill is the conceptual + operational reference for the nexus.
